art_{grid_layout}_include_grid_{window}.note: Include conditions: some content type in this window shows Grid in this cell's art, and Grid size (a Skin setting) is this cell's, so only that cell's item layouts load.

display_{item}_include_strip_{window}.note: Include conditions: some content type in this window shows Strip with this art (vue_strip), so only that art's vue loads.

display_{item}_include_showcase_{window}.note: Include conditions: some content type in this window shows Showcase with this art (vue_reel), so only that art's vue loads.

rules.condition: In({display}, [posters, fanart, square]) + equals({item}, background) + In({content_type}, [movies, sets, tvshows, seasons, episodes, artists, musicvideos])
In({display}, [posters, fanart, square]) + equals({item}, thumbnails) + not In({content_type}, [movies, sets, tvshows, seasons, episodes, artists, musicvideos])

art_{item}_visible.note: C2's names: the art family the visible window's view draws its focused item in (label_multiart_primary). List's Background and Billboard are fanart; List's Thumbnails follows Viewtype_50_List.xml: fanart (16:9) for videos and episodes, square for Containers_Square, poster for the rest. A kind shown outside its own window (music videos in Music, add-ons in Videos) gets List there (layout_list_visible_{window}'s fallback) with its List display, as display_{item}_visible counts it: so a kind on List tests no window, and one on another layout tests not its own window there. Thumbnails draws no 16:9 art outside Videos.

rules.condition: In({layout}, [showcase, strip, grid]) + In({display}_{item}, [posters_poster, fanart_fanart, square_square])
equals({layout}, list) + equals({display}, thumbnails) + In({content_type}_{item}, [videos_fanart, episodes_fanart])
equals({layout}, list) + equals({display}, thumbnails) + In({content_type}_{item}, [artists_square, albums_square, songs_square, addons_square, program_addons_square, images_square])
equals({layout}, list) + equals({display}_{item}, thumbnails_poster) + not In({content_type}, [videos, episodes, artists, albums, songs, addons, program_addons, images])
In({display}, [posters, fanart, square]) + equals({item}, fanart) + In({content_type}, [movies, sets, tvshows, seasons, episodes, artists, musicvideos])
not equals({layout}, list) + equals({display}, thumbnails) + In({content_type}_{item}, [artists_square, albums_square, songs_square, addons_square, program_addons_square, images_square])
In({display}, [posters, fanart, square]) + In({content_type}_{item}, [albums_square, songs_square, addons_square, program_addons_square, images_square])
not equals({layout}, list) + equals({display}_{item}, thumbnails_poster) + not In({content_type}, [videos, episodes, artists, albums, songs, addons, program_addons, images])
In({display}, [posters, fanart, square]) + equals({item}, poster) + In({content_type}, [program_folders, program_files, favourites])

art_keyart_visible.note: The visible window's art_keyart_visible_{window}, for art shared by every media window (texture_primary_*). Grid also shows keyart under its title or info overlay, as it always has. Showcase Posters under its details over the art too (the poster slots test those details themselves; this one is for label_multiart_primary, and only poster slots draw in Showcase Posters, blk_layouts).

rules.condition: equals({art_keyart}, true) + In({layout}, [list, showcase, strip, grid])
not equals({art_keyart}, true) + equals({layout}, grid) + In({details}, [title, info])
not equals({art_keyart}, true) + equals({layout}, showcase) + equals({display}, posters) + In({details}, [title_overlay, info_overlay])

art_keyart_logo_visible.note: Showcase Posters with its logo beside the art: an item with a clearlogo shows its keyart, so the poster's own title doesn't repeat the logo (Ash, 26 Nov); the poster slots and label_multiart test the item's clearlogo.

rules.condition: not equals({art_keyart}, true) + equals({layout}, showcase) + equals({display}, posters) + equals({logo}, on) + not In({details}, [off, title_overlay, info_overlay])
equals({art_keyart}, true) + In({layout}, [list, showcase, strip, grid])

art_landscape_visible.note: The visible window's art_landscape_visible_{window}, for art shared by every media window (texture_primary_*).

trailer_include_{window}.note: Include conditions: some kind of item in this window plays trailers (btn_trailer, the black cover, the fades).

trailer_visible_{window}.note: btn_trailer's enabled: the shown kind of item plays trailers.
